pieces.name: +25 health
pieces.about: A white box with a red cross, turning over a ring: +25 health, up to 100.

pieces.name: +50 armor
pieces.about: A yellow shard: +50 armor, up to 150. Armor takes two thirds of the damage you take, while it lasts.

pieces.name: Health Orb
pieces.about: A blue sphere: +100 health, up to 200. The radar shows when it comes back.

pieces.name: Grenade launcher
pieces.about: The grenade launcher on its pad, with a full load. One you have already tops you up.

pieces.name: Rocket launcher
pieces.about: The rocket launcher on its pad, with a full load. One you have already tops you up.

pieces.name: Spark gun
pieces.about: The spark gun on its pad, with a full load. One you have already tops you up.

pieces.name: Railgun
pieces.about: The railgun on its pad, with a full load. One you have already tops you up.

pieces.name: Jump pad
pieces.about: A glowing ring, 2 m across, with a column of light over it: it throws whoever steps on it onto the spot its placement names. Nothing breaks it.

pieces.name: Crate
pieces.about: A wooden crate, 2 m on a side. Three bullets break each half-metre of it off.

pieces.name: Low crate
pieces.about: A crate 2 m across and 1 m high: you jump onto it.

pieces.name: Box
pieces.about: A dark wooden box, 1 m on a side: you jump onto it.

pieces.name: Barrier
pieces.about: A concrete barrier, 4 m long, waist high: cover to crouch behind.

pieces.name: Cover wall
pieces.about: A brick wall, 3 m long and 2 m high: cover to stand behind.

pieces.name: Stack of sleepers
pieces.about: Railway sleepers in a stack, 4 by 2 m and 1.5 m high, a step on top.

pieces.name: Bench
pieces.about: A wooden bench, 2 m long.

pieces.name: Lamp post
pieces.about: A steel post, 3 m high.

pieces.name: Planter
pieces.about: A hedge in a square, 2 m across and 1 m high.

pieces.name: Haystack
pieces.about: Hay in two tiers, 3 m across: one hit takes each bit off, and blown loose it falls in heaps.

pieces.name: Boulder
pieces.about: A rock in two tiers, 3 by 2 m and 2 m high.

pieces.name: Tree
pieces.about: A trunk 1 m thick and 4 m high under a crown of leaves in three tiers. Cut through the trunk and the top falls.

pieces.name: Tall tree
pieces.about: A tree with a trunk 5 m high.

pieces.name: Doorway
pieces.about: A hole 2 m wide and 2.5 m high through a wall half a metre thick: place it on the wall, after the wall.

pieces.name: Window
pieces.about: A hole 2 m wide and 1 m high, 1.5 m up a wall half a metre thick: place it on the wall, after the wall.
